title: U6 Travelling around China 词汇讲义

phrases.text: around the world = all over the world = across the world

examples.en: The Earth turns around the Sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕着太阳转。

examples.en: Li Bailing is showing Harry around her school.
examples.zh: 李百灵正带着Harry参观她的学校。

examples.en: The students are running around outside.
examples.zh: 学生们在外面到处跑。

entries.notes: 作介词表示"在…周围"，作副词表示"到处；大约"

examples.en: You look tired. I think you should take a vacation.
examples.zh: 你看上去有点累。我觉得你应该休个假。

examples.en: They are on vacation in Germany.
examples.zh: 他们在德国度假。

entries.meaning: （短途往返的）旅行；旅游；出行；绊；绊倒 (tripped-tripped)

phrases.text: go on a trip to sp.

examples.en: —I will visit Beijing next month. —Have a nice trip.
examples.zh: ——我下个月要去北京。——旅途愉快。

examples.en: She tripped and fell.
examples.zh: 她绊了一下摔倒了。

entries.notes: 辨析：trip 通常指往返旅行（a three-day trip 三日游）；journey 尤指长途旅行（the journey to the west 西天取经）；tour 指游览多地的旅行；outing 指集体远足（an autumn outing 秋游）。trip 作动词"绊倒"注意双写 p

entries.meaning: 大众喜爱的；广受欢迎的；当红的 (more popular-most popular)

examples.en: Keeping pets is becoming popular.
examples.zh: 养宠物正变得很流行。

examples.en: Our PE teacher is very popular among his students.
examples.zh: 我们的体育老师很受学生欢迎。

examples.en: Rock climbing is growing in popularity these days.
examples.zh: 攀岩这些天变得越来越受欢迎了。

entries.notes: 词族：popularity n. 流行（gain popularity 越来越受欢迎）；unpopular adj. 不受欢迎的

entries.meaning: 旅行；旅游；在…旅游；在…巡回演出

phrases.text: go on a tour to sp.

examples.en: Shall we go on a tour to Europe this winter?
examples.zh: 我们今年冬天去欧洲旅游好吗？

examples.en: We spent four weeks touring in Europe.
examples.zh: 我们花四个星期周游欧洲。

entries.notes: 词族：tourist n. 游客；tourism n. 旅游业

phrases.text: tips on how to do sth.

examples.en: Here are a few useful tips on how to save money.
examples.zh: 这里有几个省钱的窍门。

examples.en: The book introduces many gardening tips.
examples.zh: 这本书介绍了很多园艺技巧。

entries.notes: 近义词：suggestion（可数）、advice（不可数）。习语：on the tip of your tongue 话到嘴边（却一时想不起来）；the tip of the iceberg 冰山一角

examples.en: I left chains of footprints on the beach.
examples.zh: 我在沙滩上留下了串串脚印。

entries.notes: 合成词：foot（脚）+ print（印迹）

examples.en: They hike on Mount Huangshan.
examples.zh: 他们在黄山徒步。

examples.en: If the weather is fine, we will go hiking this weekend.
examples.zh: 如果天气好，我们这周末去远足。

entries.notes: hiker n. 徒步旅行者；hitchhiker n. 搭便车的人

examples.en: Water is one of the most important natural resources.
examples.zh: 水是最重要的自然资源之一。

examples.en: Naturally, I get upset when I don't get along with my classmates.
examples.zh: 当我和同学合不来时，我当然会不开心。

entries.notes: 词族：natural adj. 自然的 ↔ unnatural adj. 不自然的；naturally adv. 自然地；当然

phrases.text: enjoy oneself = have a good time = have fun

examples.en: I enjoy playing basketball and tennis.
examples.zh: 我喜欢打篮球和网球。

examples.en: To our great joy, we won the football match.
examples.zh: 令我们大为高兴的是，我们赢得了足球比赛。

examples.en: We live an enjoyable school life.
examples.zh: 我们过着愉快的学校生活。

entries.notes: 词族：joy n. 乐趣（jump for joy 欢呼雀跃）；enjoyable adj. 令人愉快的

examples.en: Shanghai is located in the east of China.
examples.zh: 上海位于中国的东部。

examples.en: Can you tell me the location of the fire exit?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我消防出口的位置吗？

entries.notes: 词族：locate v. 定位；location n. 位置；方位；local 作名词指"当地人"

phrases.text: enjoy some lazy days on the beach
phrases.meaning: 在海滩享受几天悠闲时光

examples.en: He woke up and stretched lazily.
examples.zh: 他醒来伸了个懒腰。

entries.notes: 反义词：hardworking adj. 工作努力的。变 y 为 i 的词形变化：lazy→lazily/laziness；同类：easy→easily, busy→busily/business, heavy→heavily, happy→happily/happiness, noisy→noisily, lonely→loneliness

examples.en: The kids pulled him off the horseback.
examples.zh: 孩子们把他从马背上拉了下来。

entries.notes: 合成词：horse（马）+ back（背）

examples.en: Look at the red walls and yellow roofs.
examples.zh: 看那些红墙黄屋顶。

entries.notes: 习语：hit the roof = become very angry 勃然大怒。以 f 结尾变复数直接 +s 的名词：roof→roofs 屋顶、proof→proofs 证据、belief→beliefs 信念、chief→chiefs 首领、cliff→cliffs 悬崖

examples.en: Lu Yao went skiing with her family in France last February.
examples.zh: 陆瑶去年二月和家人去法国滑雪了。

examples.en: I want to try skiing in Harbin.
examples.zh: 我想在哈尔滨试试滑雪。

examples.en: It's easy to take up cross-country skiing.
examples.zh: 从事越野滑雪是容易的。

entries.notes: skier n. 滑雪者

examples.en: He left without giving a reason.
examples.zh: 他没有说明理由就走了。

examples.en: For these reasons, Lu Yao chose to go to Chengdu for a vacation.
examples.zh: 由于这些原因，陆瑶选择去成都度假。

entries.notes: 词族：reasonable adj. 合理的 ↔ unreasonable adj. 不合理的；reasonably adv. 合理地。形容词前加 un 变反义词：happy→unhappy、lucky→unlucky、kind→unkind、important→unimportant、comfortable→uncomfortable、tidy→untidy、usual→unusual、necessary→unnecessary

examples.en: I'd like to book a table for two tonight.
examples.zh: 我想订一张今晚的二人餐桌。

entries.notes: book 除了"书"，作动词常考"预订"

phrases.text: driving licence (英式) / driver's licence (美式)

examples.en: Don't drive so fast!
examples.zh: 不要开那么快！

examples.en: It's a three-hour drive to London.
examples.zh: 到伦敦要三小时车程。

entries.notes: driver n. 司机；drive 作名词表示"车程"

entries.meaning: （同 I 和 we 连用，表示将来）将要；将会

examples.en: —Shall I book a plane ticket for you? —That's kind of you.
examples.zh: ——要我为你订一张机票吗？——你真好。

examples.en: —Shall we go to Chengdu by plane? —That's a good idea.
examples.zh: ——我们乘飞机去成都如何？——真是个好主意。

entries.notes: Shall 与 I/we 连用、用于疑问句，表示提供帮助或提出建议

phrases.meaning: 我恐怕（是这样/不是这样）——礼貌地说出令人不快或遗憾的事

examples.en: I'm afraid it is a little too expensive.
examples.zh: 我恐怕有点太贵了。

examples.en: —Does it hurt? —I'm afraid so.
examples.zh: ——痛不痛？——恐怕会痛。

examples.en: Many people are afraid of spiders.
examples.zh: 很多人害怕蜘蛛。

examples.en: I'm afraid of going out alone at night.
examples.zh: 我害怕夜间单独外出。

entries.notes: 另外两个表示害怕的词：frightened、scared

entries.meaning: 昂贵的；价格高的 (more expensive-most expensive)

examples.en: Everything is so expensive now, isn't it?
examples.zh: 现在什么东西都那么贵，是不是？

entries.notes: 近义词：dear；反义词：cheap（cheaper-cheapest）；expense n. 费用；开销（通常用复数：living/medical expenses 生活/医疗费用）

examples.en: The price of a one-way ticket is over 1300 yuan.
examples.zh: 单程票的价格是1300多元。

examples.en: He sold his car at a high price.
examples.zh: 他以高价出售了他的小汽车。

entries.notes: 问价格：How much does one cabbage cost? = What's the price of one cabbage? = How much is it? priceless adj. 无价的；极珍贵的（priceless information = valuable information）

examples.en: Don't enter. Here is the one-way traffic.
examples.zh: 不要进入。这里是单行道。

phrases.meaning: …的票（two tickets for tonight's film 两张今晚的电影票）
去…的票（a plane ticket to Beijing 去北京的机票）
违章停车/超速驾驶罚款单

examples.en: I have got two tickets for tonight's film.
examples.zh: 我有两张今晚的电影票。

examples.en: Shall I book a plane ticket to Beijing for you?
examples.zh: 要我为你订一张去北京的机票吗？

entries.meaning: （good 的比较级）较好的；更好的；（well 的比较级）更好

examples.en: We are hoping for better weather tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们希望明天天气好转。

examples.en: Her work is getting better and better.
examples.zh: 她的工作正变得越来越好。

examples.en: Lu Yao sings much better than I do.
examples.zh: 陆瑶唱歌比我好得多。

examples.en: You'd better go to the doctor at once if a dog or cat bites you.
examples.zh: 如果狗或猫咬了你，你最好立刻去看医生。

examples.en: You'd better not go to bed too late, or you will feel sleepy in class.
examples.zh: 你最好不要睡得太晚，否则你会在课堂上打瞌睡。

entries.notes: 不规则比较级表：good/well→better→best；many/much→more→most；little→less→least；bad/badly/ill→worse→worst；far→farther/further→farthest/furthest。You'd better = You had better

entries.meaning: 方便的；便利的；省事的 (more convenient-most convenient)

examples.en: It's convenient to travel by high-speed train in China.
examples.zh: 在中国，乘高铁出行是很方便的。

examples.en: A bicycle is more convenient than a car in the town.
examples.zh: 在小镇上自行车常常比小汽车更方便。

entries.notes: 词族：convenience n. 方便（convenience store 便利店）；inconvenient adj. 不方便的

entries.meaning: 速度；快速前行；加速 (sped-sped 或 speeded-speeded)

examples.en: The car runs at a speed of 80 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 轿车以每小时八十英里的速度行驶。

examples.en: The ambulance sped to the hospital.
examples.zh: 救护车快速开往医院。

examples.en: We'd better speed up if we want to get there in time.
examples.zh: 如果我们想准时到达那里，我们最好加快速度。

entries.notes: high-speed adj. 高速的：They are planning to build a new high-speed railway line between the two cities. 他们计划在这两个城市之间建设一条新的高速铁路线。

entries.meaning: 使人舒服的；舒适的 (more comfortable-most comfortable)

examples.en: I feel much more comfortable in my new clothes.
examples.zh: 我穿上新衣服感觉舒服多了。

examples.en: They can sit comfortably in the large armchairs.
examples.zh: 他们可以舒服地坐在宽大的扶手椅上。

examples.en: There's nothing like the comfort of a warm bed on a cold night.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚，没有什么比一张温暖的床更让人感到舒适的了。

examples.en: I tried to comfort her with a packet of sweets.
examples.zh: 我试图用一包糖果去安慰她。

entries.notes: 词族：comfortably adv. 舒服地；comfort n. 舒适；安慰，v. 安慰某人（comfort sb. = give sb. comfort）；uncomfortable adj. 不舒服的

entries.meaning: 景色；（尤指）乡间美景；视野；（个人的）看法

examples.en: We have a beautiful view of the lake from our hotel room.
examples.zh: 从我们的酒店房间可以看到湖的美丽景色。

examples.en: In view of the recent accidents, safety tips should be taught at school.
examples.zh: 鉴于最近的事故，学校应该教授一些安全贴士。

examples.en: The actress disappeared out of view into the crowd.
examples.zh: 这个女演员消失在人群中，看不见了。

entries.meaning: 拿；提；搬运；运送；输送；传播 (carried-carried-carrying)

examples.en: She carried the heavy box up the stairs.
examples.zh: 她把沉重的箱子搬上了楼梯。

examples.en: The train carries passengers from one city to another.
examples.zh: 火车把乘客从一个城市运送到另一个城市。

examples.en: Mosquitoes can carry diseases.
examples.zh: 蚊子可以传播疾病。

examples.en: They carried out the plan successfully.
examples.zh: 他们成功地执行了计划。

entries.notes: 辨析：take 从说话者所在处带走；bring 带到说话者所在处；fetch 去某地取回（往返）；carry 侧重物理上的搬运/支撑，不强调方向

entries.meaning: 计划；方案；打算；计划；打算 (planned-planned-planning)

examples.en: I plan to go to the movies tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我打算明天去看电影。

examples.en: They planned a surprise party for her birthday.
examples.zh: 他们为她的生日计划了一个惊喜派对。

entries.notes: 注意双写 n：planned, planning

examples.en: She likes to work on her own.
examples.zh: 她喜欢独自工作。

examples.en: He bought a house of his own.
examples.zh: 他买了一栋属于自己的房子。

examples.en: The ownership of the company has changed hands several times.
examples.zh: 这家公司的所有权已经几次易手。

entries.notes: 词族：owner n. 所有者；物主（a business owner 企业主）；ownership n. 所有权；物主身份

examples.en: The national team is preparing for the World Cup.
examples.zh: 国家队正在为世界杯做准备。

examples.en: English is an international language.
examples.zh: 英语是一门国际语言。

entries.notes: 词族：nation n. 国家；nationally adv. 全国性地；nationality n. 国籍；international adj. 国际的

entries.meaning: 志愿者；义务工作者；自愿提供；自愿参加

examples.en: I volunteered for the project.
examples.zh: 我自愿参加了这个项目。

entries.notes: voluntary adj. 自愿的（voluntary donation 自愿捐赠）

entries.meaning: 过得快乐；玩得高兴（= have a good time = have fun）

phrases.meaning: 请自便；自取（食物、饮料等）

phrases.text: look at oneself in the mirror

examples.en: We are going to a concert tonight, and I am really looking forward to enjoying myself.
examples.zh: 我们今晚要去听音乐会，我非常期待玩得开心。

entries.notes: look forward to + doing（to 是介词）：looking forward to enjoying myself = looking forward to having fun / having a good time
